messages:
anya: Quick sync — routing policy roadmap checkpoint. Need to lock scope for Q3 launch. Customer asks from Acme & FinCo: region pinning, per-tenant isolation, predictable latency (p99 < 350ms), and automatic fallback. Can we align on minimum viable scope?
sam: +1. Do we consider tenant slices as soft isolation vs hard tenancy? soft = namespaces + routing labels; hard = dedicated pools.
miguel: For MVIs I prefer soft isolation with affinity + egress controls. Hard tenancy increases infra cost 2-3x. We can offer hard as enterprise add-on.
lee: Agree. Also need rollout gating: canary at 5% traffic, error budget 0.5% over 1h, automatic rollback if >3% spike.
tess: Product ask: provide per-tenant SLA dashboard in Redwood Console. Also need migration path for customers on single-region to multi-region.
anya: Good. For region pinning we need consistent KV cache across regions or deterministic cache key strategy. Miguel, can runtime support prefix KV replication?
miguel: Short answer: not yet. Options: 1) synchronous replication (latency costly), 2) async replication w/ staleness window, 3) route read-only to local cache + authoritative writes to primary. I'd pick (3) for MVI.
sam: Timeline? If we choose (3) estimate 4 engineers 6 weeks (design+impl+tests).
anya: Customers pushing for rollout by end of Q3. If 6 weeks, we need to prioritize. What can we drop from MVP to hit date?
lee: Drop hard tenancy from MVP. Also postpone per-tenant SLA exports; provide basic metrics in console first.
tess: Also need launch criteria checklist: canary stability (7 days), perf within 15% of baseline, docs + SDK flags, runbook.
anya: I'll draft launch checklist. Action items: Miguel to prototype cache strategy, Sam to scope routing policy config UI, Lee to define canary rollback automation, Tess to draft customer migration guide. Owners?
sam: I'll own routing UI.
miguel: I'll prototype cache strategy — ETA 3 weeks for POC.
lee: I'll own rollback automation + test harness.
tess: I'll draft migration guide and customer comms.
anya: Cool. Quick note on pricing: finance wants conservative cost model. We'll need telemetry hooks to model per-tenant unit cost.
sam: Add a flag to route to 'isolated' pools for enterprise tiers.
infra-bot: scheduled: infra-maintenance at 2026-07-05T03:00Z (no impact expected) :wrench:
anya: Thanks team. I'll schedule an architecture sync tomorrow 10am to finalize scope. If anyone objects speak now, otherwise I'll mark scope as: region pinning (soft), tenant affinity + soft isolation, canary+rollback, console metrics. Hard tenancy & SLA exports deferred.
miguel: No objections from infra side.
lee: +1
tess: +1
sam: +1
